prompt: Our Qdrant cluster memory keeps growing slowly, about 10-12 MB per day, even though we're not ingesting any new data. We've restarted the nodes a few times and memory drops immediately, but then it starts climbing again. We're on version 1.13. Is this a memory leak?

assertions.text: Identifies this as the Phase 3A memory growth pattern
Mentions the 1-12 MB/day growth is a known issue in versions before v1.13
Does NOT dismiss restart behavior as proof it was 'just cache'
Recommends checking GET /telemetry to separate data from cache
Recommends checking collection count for overhead
Recommends upgrading to latest version and escalating to support if persists
